title: Doctors Orders (ORIGINAL)
description: A direct and dangerous follow up to the dark events of "Take Your Medicine". This sequel sees you, the listener, once more returning to take your place as 'Patient 207' at the New Foundation for Experimental Scientific Research. What was to be a routine checkup has instead resurfaced some... uncomfortable memories... and you now wish to launch a formal complaint about your treatment at the New Foundation. Of course patient care is paramount and you're swiftly assured that this can all be easily resolved. Luckily for you the operating theatre is already prepped ready with the appropriate rectal reprogramming devices. And a simple adjustment to your medical dosage, along with an emergency appointment to the lead professional, Doctor Shibby, should put all your concerns to rest. Normally corrective procedures are not required... But in your case the Doctor is willing to make an exception. Instructions For this file it is essential that you wear a condom. Make sure it is correctly on before you lie down and press play. For the most immersive experience you should also consider popping in a butt-plug and having a glass of water to sip and rehydrate. Do so in a safe manner and at your own risk.
author: Mistress Shibby
